priorities.summary: Injection-class vulnerability (CWE-74) in Cisco's Unified Communications family — Emergency Responder, Unified CM, Unity Connection and others — network-reachable without authentication. Part of Cisco's October 21 hardening release; fixed in 15SU5, no workarounds.

Improper-authentication vulnerability (CWE-287) across Cisco's Unified Communications products, exploitable remotely without credentials. Disclosed in Cisco's October 21 security hardening release alongside 7 other grouped CVEs; fixed in 15SU5, no workarounds.

Cross-site scripting vulnerability class (CWE-79) in Cisco Unified Communications products scoring 9.3. Found by Cisco's internal testing (aided by frontier AI models) and patched in the October 21 hardening release; fixed in 15SU5, no workarounds.

model.name: Claude Duet
model.summary: Anthropic's new standalone proactive AI agent, built on Opus 5.5, that monitors connected apps, sends a morning brief, and completes tasks in its own cloud VM — its answer to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots. Available as a waitlisted research preview for US Pro/Max subscribers on iOS, Android and claude.ai.
